ढिंडोरा के दीवानों, हो जाओ तैयार क्योंकि भुवन बाम फिर से मचाने आ गए हैं धमाल! 🍿

पाँच साल बाद BB Ki Vines का यह यूनिवर्स अब Netflix पर दस्तक दे रहा है।
भुवन बाम एक बार फिर दस अलग किरदारों में नजर आएंगे जिनमें टीटू मामा और बबलू जी जैसे नाम शामिल हैं।
सीरीज में संजीव शेख की Kavita Mami के रूप में धमाकेदार एंट्री हुई है जो टीटू मामा को कड़ी टक्कर दे रही हैं।
Sneha Shetty Kohli इस प्रोजेक्ट के साथ अपना डायरेक्शन डेब्यू कर रही हैं।
ट्रेलर में Udit Narayan, Anup Soni और Orry जैसे सितारों के कैमियो ने एक्साइटमेंट बढ़ा दी है।
यह शो 20 नवंबर को रिलीज हो रहा है और इसमें देसी कॉमेडी के साथ भरपूर एक्शन देखने को मिलेगा। 🔥

क्या आप टीटू मामा और Kavita Mami की नोक-झोंक देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇✨

ctx.title: Dhindora 2 Trailer Review: Bhuvan Bam & Sanjeeda Sheikh Are Promising A Riot, But Saiyaara Dig & Udit Narayan’s Jhalak Is Why I’m Hooked!
ctx.summary:
Bhuvan Bam's characters in Dhindora were already a riot and he seems to escalate the fun in season 2 for sure - Dhindora 2 trailer review. 
 The post  Dhindora 2 Trailer Review: Bhuvan Bam & Sanjeeda Sheikh Are Promising A Riot, But Saiyaara Dig & Udit Narayan’s Jhalak Is Why I’m Hooked!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Five years after Dhindora became a digital sensation on YouTube, Bhuvan Bam brings his beloved BB Ki Vines universe to Netflix, and the stakes have multiplied. Season 2 is back with Bam, slipping seamlessly across ten distinct characters – including Titu Mama, Babloo Ji, Janki, Sameer, and Bancho. Bhuvan’s effortless switch between these avatars still seems to be the USP of the show!
However, the standout addition is Sanjeeda Sheikh as Kavita Mami. Holding her own against Titu Mama’s nonstop excuses, Sanjeeda is promising a tremendous screen presence, sparking instant comic chemistry with Bhuvan. Veteran actor Kanwaljit Singh adds solid weight as the intimidating father-in-law, while brief flashes of Udit Narayan and Anup Soni promise laugh-out-loud meta moments. Making her directorial debut, Sneha Shetty Kohli has kept the trailer punchy and balanced with Bhuvan’s signature raw humor.
The cheeky Bollywood digs & star cameos are intriguing enough and so well used in this trailer! The sly meta-dig at Saiyaara alongside surprise glimpses of Udit Narayan, Crime Patrol host Anup Soni, and Orry instantly elevates the pop-culture quotient of this trailer!
Moving from YouTube to Netflix, the production has scaled up properly, complete with action antics and song-and-dance, without losing the chaotic middle-class charm of BB Ki Vines.
The trailer for Dhindora Season 2 is hitting every right note – scaling up the visual canvas for Netflix while keeping Titu Mama’s desi madness completely intact. Powered by Bhuvan Bam’s multi-character brilliance, Sanjeeda Sheikh’s firecracker entry as Kavita Mami, and hilarious cameos led by Udit Narayan , Season 2 looks primed to deliver a binge-worthy comedy riot when it drops on November 20!
Having grown from a fan-favorite digital series into a Netflix title, the show keeps Bhuvan Bam’s signature mix of larger-than-life characters and desi humor. With Kavita Mami in the picture, Titu Mama had better buckle up because sasural ki kahaani ab aur bhi interesting hone wali hai!
